name: Tinzaparin
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

usual_adult_dose.indication: Treatment of deep vein thrombosis and pulmonary embolism
usual_adult_dose.dose: 175 anti-Xa IU/kg SC once daily for at least 6 days and until oral anticoagulation is established

usual_adult_dose.indication: Extended treatment of cancer-associated venous thromboembolism
usual_adult_dose.dose: 175 anti-Xa IU/kg SC once daily for 6 months; reassess beyond

key_interactions.drug_or_class: Antiplatelets, NSAIDs, thrombolytics, vitamin K antagonists, other anticoagulants

serious: Spinal or epidural hematoma with neuraxial anesthesia

contraindications: Current or past immune heparin-induced thrombocytopenia
Active major bleeding or high bleeding risk

pk.half_life_eskd: About 2.5 hours after an IV bolus in dialysis patients; no accumulation down to CrCl 20
pk.excretion_renal_pct: Mainly renal (unchanged or nearly unchanged), with significant non-renal elimination

sources.citation: Leo Laboratories Limited. (2024). innohep 14,000 IU/0.7 mL solution for injection (tinzaparin sodium) [Summary of product characteristics, licence PA0046/060/011; text revised November 2024]. Health Products Regulatory Authority (Ireland).
